request_policy.messages: exact frozen messages; no examples, history, tools or dependency map
request_policy.resume: Never resubmit a dispatched request; inspect durable ledger and obtain user direction after interruption

primary_outcome: Both clients and complete repository verify, after tolerant extraction and protected edit guard, on the first response.
failure_policy: Format, guard, resolution, parse and proof failures count as unsuccessful trials. Infrastructure failures stop the run and are reported separately; unattempted trials are not model failures.
analysis: Report each of four cells separately with numerator/denominator and paired block outcomes. Depth and sharing differences are descriptive; repetitions of one task are not independent task samples.
authorization: No dispatcher or model calls in this preparation. Execution requires separate explicit user authorization.
